incidents.body:
Some of our services were impacted by a DNS issue between 14:35 and 15:35 UTC.
During this time: clicks and impressions processing was delayed, which resulted in a temporary increase in organic attribution; the Onelink API was partially available; and some processed events are missing geo data.
The issue has been fully resolved.
Please contact our support team with any questions.
incidents.title: Dashboards availability

incidents.body:
We are seeing significantly fewer reports related to domain mapping and expect the DNS propagation process to complete in the coming hours. 
We are marking this incident as resolved.
If you have any questions or need assistance, our team is available to help.
